name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
role: Main: daily prices and the futures/VIX/DXY strip
notes: Unofficial, through yfinance. Verified: daily history for all 27 seeded symbols incl. the strip (ES=F, NQ=F, YM=F, RTY=F, GC=F, CL=F, SI=F, ^GSPC, ^VIX, DX-Y.NYB, ^TNX); intraday 1m (7 days), 5m (60 days), 1h (730 days). No spot gold symbol (XAUUSD=X not found). Futures (=F) series are display-only, never backtested.

name: Yahoo Finance RSS
notes: feeds.finance.yahoo.com/rss/2.0/headline?s=SYMBOL. No key. Returns only the latest 20 items per symbol.

name: Finnhub
role: Main: quotes and company news. Backup: earnings calendar
notes: Free: 60 calls/min, 1 year of company news. Quote, company-news and earnings calendar returned data on the free key.

name: Financial Modeling Prep
role: Main: earnings calendar. Fundamentals from v1.0.8
notes: Free: 250 calls/day, /stable/ endpoints only. quote, earnings-calendar, profile, income-statement, balance-sheet-statement, cash-flow-statement, ratios, key-metrics all returned data on the free key.

name: Tiingo
role: Backup: daily prices, and cross-check for backfills

name: Twelve Data
notes: Basic plan: 8 calls/min, 800/day. Probe: XAU/USD works; SPX needs Pro, GC needs Grow; VIX, DXY, NQ rejected; ES and CL resolve to stocks. Does not cover indices or futures on the free plan.

name: Massive (formerly Polygon.io)
role: Backup: futures on the strip (about 8 hours late). Additive: company news
notes: Free Futures Basic and Stocks Basic plans: 5 calls/min, 2 years of history, non-professional use. Futures: real dated contracts for ES, NQ, YM, RTY, GC, CL, SI; daily session bars with settlement; minute data about 8 hours old. News: per-ticker, with Massive's own sentiment label kept as a reference only. Display-only for futures, never backtested.

name: Stooq
role: Dropped (key pending). Would be a second strip backup
notes: Dropped 2026-11-11: programmatic access needs an API key (policy since 2026-04); a key was requested by email and has not arrived. Nothing waits on it: Massive is the futures backup. No adapter is written. If a key arrives: put it in STOOQ_API_KEY, write and contract-test the adapter, set the status back to working. Format when keyed: /q/d/l/?s=SYMBOL&i=d, Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume.

name: FRED / ALFRED
role: Main: macro series, rates, Fed panel, first-published vintages

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
notes: Free v2 key. CPI series CUUR0000SA0 returned data.

name: StockTwits
role: Additive: bull/bear ratio for the composite score
notes: Unofficial public endpoint /api/2/streams/symbol/{TICKER}.json, no key, no account. One cached fetch per watchlist ticker per day. Never required: no labeled messages or endpoint down means news-only.

name: SearXNG (self-hosted)
notes: Runs in Docker Compose, JSON output. News category answered from bing news, brave.news, duckduckgo news, wikinews. Not answering on the verify date: google news (access denied), reuters (HTTP error), duckduckgo general (CAPTCHA).

name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (Socrata)
role: COT history for backtests; live weekly job from v1.2
notes: Free, no key. Socrata dataset 6dca-aqww (legacy, futures only). Gold (088691): weekly reports 1986-01-15 onwards. Report date is a Tuesday; published the following Friday.
